label: Content Strategy Planning
description: Develop content strategies for publications, brands, and organisations: audience analysis, content pillars, editorial calendars, channel strategies, and measurement frameworks.

modelTier.notes: Sonnet for most content strategy work. Opus for complex multi-channel enterprise content strategies.

guidedInputs.label: Organisation & Content Context
guidedInputs.description: Who is the organisation or publication? What content do they currently produce? What problem are they trying to solve?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. B2B fintech company. Currently produces ad-hoc blog posts, no strategy. Goal: establish thought leadership, drive inbound leads from compliance officers.

guidedInputs.label: Target Audience
guidedInputs.description: Who are the primary and secondary audiences? What are their roles, interests, and content needs?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Primary: Chief Compliance Officers at mid-size European banks (250-2,000 staff). Secondary: Compliance managers and AML analysts. They read FT, RegTech press, LinkedIn.

guidedInputs.label: Content Goals
guidedInputs.description: What should this content strategy achieve?

guidedInputs.label: Content Channels
guidedInputs.description: Which channels should the strategy cover?

guidedInputs.label: Resources & Constraints
guidedInputs.description: Team size, budget, time commitment, existing assets.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. 1 part-time content manager, budget €2k/month, 2 subject matter experts available for 2 hours/week each.
